name: Jellyfin New Releases
description: Tracks releases by the library artists in your Jellyfin music library that the library does not yet contain. A daily Refresh reads MusicBrainz and Deezer, decides ownership by track list, and lists Missing, Incomplete and Upcoming releases in a New Releases view; users can Ignore a release or mark it Have it.
overview: Releases by your library artists that your library does not have yet.
